notes.zh: 审阅注：玩家下令将舰队独立为佣兵城邦时触发（on_establish_mercenary_enclave，00_on_actions.txt:4806）；确认后由enclave.21建立城邦、开启分红局势，并立刻打开新城邦的联络菜单。佣兵城邦只会以这种方式在开局后产生（enclave_effects.txt:5）。
notes.en: Review note: fires when an empire orders a fleet to become a mercenary enclave (on_establish_mercenary_enclave, 00_on_actions.txt:4806); on acceptance enclave.21 creates the enclave, starts the dividends situation and opens the new enclave's contact menu. Mercenary enclaves only appear this way after game start (enclave_effects.txt:5).

notes.zh: 审阅注：局势属于城邦本身；完成时enclave.275按32/32/32/2/2随机向资助者（城邦所在星系的拥有者或游牧资助者）发放一份分红，并重新开始局势，因此分红会周期性重复（overlord_enclaves_events.txt:2179-2252）。
notes.en: Review note: the situation belongs to the enclave; on completion enclave.275 pays the patron (owner of the enclave's system, or a nomad patron) one dividend chosen 32/32/32/2/2 and restarts the situation, so dividends repeat (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:2179-2252).

scope.zh: 完整：建立城邦、分红循环、转入联络菜单。
scope.en: Complete: founding, dividend cycle, hand-off to the contact menu.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现佣兵城邦的名称。
note.en: In the game, the mercenary enclave's name appears here.
